```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">

  <!-- Base link: the main chest body -->
  <link name="base">
    <!-- Inertial properties -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia: Ixx = 1/12 m (h^2 + d^2), Iyy = 1/12 m (w^2 + d^2), Izz = 1/12 m (w^2 + h^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.1125" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.2265" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.2265"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Visual geometry -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.62 0.26 0.36"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision geometry -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.62 0.26 0.36"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Lid link -->
  <link name="lid">
    <!-- Inertial properties (thin plate) -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.13 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate plate inertia: thickness t=0.02 m, width w=0.62, depth d=0.26 -->
      <!-- Ixx = 1/12 m (w^2 + d^2) -->
      <!-- Iyy = 1/12 m (w^2 + t^2) -->
      <!-- Izz = 1/12 m (d^2 + t^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.0209" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.0065" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.0049"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Visual geometry -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.13 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.62 0.26 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="dark_brown">
        <color rgba="0.4 0.2 0.1 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision geometry -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.13 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.62 0.26 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinge joint for the lid -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Joint origin is at the back top edge of the chest -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.13 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit effort="20.0" velocity="1.0" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
